verdict.rationale: Docs describe an official plugin-building framework (plugin.json/Agent Plugins schema, MCP server wiring, plugin-creator/skill-installer scaffolding tools, and a submission portal) that developers can build against, which functions as a de facto SDK for extending Codex. However, there's no evidence of a formal code SDK/client library (e.g., a Python/JS package) and the OpenAPI/spec discovery probe returned 404s, suggesting no public API spec to build against beyond manifest/MCP wiring. Missing for 10: dedicated SDK libraries in specific languages, code samples/quickstarts beyond manifest scaffolding, and a working OpenAPI spec.
